title: Model Picker, Bug Fixes
description: Conductor 0.36.2 changelog - Model Picker, Bug Fixes
summary: You can now change your default model directly from the model picker: Anthropic broke context usage info in the latest SDK release, so we've temporarily removed it.
html:
You can now change your default model directly from the model picker:

Anthropic broke context usage info in the latest SDK release, so we've temporarily removed it.

Improvements

  • Added a button to copy the logs from a GitHub check
  • Switching to a different agent type (e.g., from Claude to Codex) now immediately switches to a new tab, instead of waiting to generate a summary
  • Clearer instructions for Claude’s ask-a-question tool
  • More small rendering optimizations

Fixes

  • Fixed markdown preview scroll in file and diff viewers
  • Fixed a crash that would occur when archiving workspaces
  • Fixed layout shift when creating workspaces from PRs

Lastly, a recommendation: please do not move or delete workspace or repo directories outside Conductor. It will get confused and have a bad time. We’ve added reminders about this in repo settings.
markdown:
You can now change your default model directly from the model picker:
![image](/assets/changelog/media/0.36.2/1771480180909-image.png)
Anthropic [broke context usage info](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/issues/186) in the latest SDK release, so we've temporarily removed it.

### Improvements

- Added a button to copy the logs from a GitHub check
- Switching to a different agent type (e.g., from Claude to Codex) now immediately switches to a new tab, instead of waiting to generate a summary
- Clearer instructions for Claude’s ask-a-question tool
- More small rendering optimizations

### Fixes

- Fixed markdown preview scroll in file and diff viewers
- Fixed a crash that would occur when archiving workspaces
- Fixed layout shift when creating workspaces from PRs

Lastly, a recommendation: please do not move or delete workspace or repo directories outside Conductor. It will get confused and have a bad time. We’ve added reminders about this in repo settings.
